reason: I buy to resell, so I count landed cost per piece. At 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% and delivery, cheap clothes and home items end up costing what I pay wholesale in the Baghdad market today, and I'd wait 2 to 3 weeks for it.
objection: Air shipping per kilo eats my margin on bulk orders, and 2 to 3 weeks with only 'about' on the date is risky when I have customers waiting. No word on a bulk rate or a guaranteed delivery date.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk or sea-freight rate for big 1688 orders that brings shipping well under 13,000 a kilo, with a firm delivery date.
